items.text: Nori at the lunar switchboard, waiting for the last call.

I taped over Dad's weather report for this frame. Nori's headset lights up one whole second before the phone rings. I checked twice.

~ miki
Tape 03  /  tracking a little wobbly  /  cap by spoolcat
June 8   Found the last six seconds! See the missing caller page.
A passenger pays with a shirt button. Nori keeps it in the coin tray. Watch the tray when the bus returns empty.
The hold music is Nori humming into a paper cup. The caller asks for an encore. My copy loses the sound just there.
Stop at the glass reflection. There are two headsets on the hook and only one operator on shift.
The empty chair squeaks. Nori looks straight at the unplugged jack. I wore out the pause button trying to read her lips.
A tiny voice says "save me a seat." My friend Yuu heard "save the receipt." We have agreed to disagree.
My theory: it's the night-bus driver calling from yesterday. He still owes her a button.
